title: Adversarial review
activation: a finished artifact is about to be committed to and being wrong is expensive
architecture, data model, security boundary, vendor, dependency, build-vs-buy, migration, hard-to-reverse change
a spec about to be built, a public factual claim, a decision record about to be executed, a strategy about to be funded
challenge this, try to break the case, find what is wrong with the thinking, strongest case against
challenge this decision or architecture before we commit to it
review the plan for the failure modes we have not considered
standDown: the artifact is still moving, a half-finished draft, tidy up
low-stakes reversible work, easy to change later, cheap pick
code review of a diff for style and naming
inputs: the finished artifact or decision record
the claims and alternatives it rests on
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: a verdict of rejected or needs validation returns the deliverable to its author with the failure mode named
self-review is stated in the record because a reviewer who shares the author's context shares the blind spots
